goal: Stop conflating system and runtime failures with consensus and policy invalidity in block processing
Give callers explicit error signals for fatal operational failures instead of overloaded validation states
reviewability: Reviewing the code now is worthwhile, with nothing known that would invalidate a review.
agreement: Architectural objection to value-based error returns over exceptions for fatal errors (purpleKarrot)
Warns that testing error returns with else branches risks consensus splits and slows IBD (purpleKarrot)
Concerned that miner error strings change and validation callbacks are skipped on error paths (optout21)
Concept support for separating runtime errors to make control flow explicit (optout21, hodlinator, l0rinc)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it clarifies error reporting at the kernel boundary.
Separates fatal operational failures from block validation states across the C API and C++ wrappers.

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it removes an architectural hazard where non-validating functions took validation parameters.
